title: Expected-time and polynomial-time BPP coincide
statement: The class of languages decidable by a finite-state randomized Turing machine whose expected running time is polynomial in the input length and whose probability of producing the correct answer can be made at least $2/3-\varepsilon$ for every $\varepsilon>0$ equals the class decidable in polynomial worst-case time with probability at least $2/3$ of producing the correct answer.
